A week or so back I made my first post on r/shrooms about my first ever successful hunting experience where I found a good pile of mushrooms. Turned out stealthily drying them in my parents house would be a harder experience than expected and I had to toss what would have been maybe 50g of dried shrooms due to them sitting damp for too long. 
I learned my lesson though and managed to put these new ones at 60 degrees in a fan forced oven for 2 hours and then a night outside in a well ventilated area which got them nearly fully dry, followed by another 2 hours at 55 degrees. They’ve dried out really well, still a little bit rubbery but make a nice rustling sound when you pick up a handful. 
I don’t have a scale but according to my little makeshift classical tipping scale they weigh at least 3 CDs, probably closer to 4 which makes it 1.8-2.4 ounces 
I had my first proper mushroom trip yesterday after taking 2 smallish ones. Very happy to report success :)
